title: Set 160

sentences.ko: 토요일에 시댁에 차 타고 올라갔는데, 잠깐 들렀다 오려던 게 시아버지가 울타리 고치는 걸 도와 달라고 하셔서 집에 열 시쯤에나 들어왔어.
sentences.text: We drove up to see my in-laws on Saturday, and it was supposed to be a quick visit, but my father-in-law wanted help fixing the fence, so we didn't get home until like ten.

alts.text: Saturday we went up to my in-laws'. Was supposed to be quick, but my father-in-law wanted a hand with the fence, so we didn't get back till like ten.
On Saturday we drove up to visit my in-laws. It was meant to be a brief visit, but my father-in-law asked for help repairing the fence, so we did not arrive home until around ten.

sentences.note: **drove up to** 는 차를 타고 (보통 북쪽이나 먼 곳으로) 올라간다는 말이에요. **in-laws** 는 배우자의 부모님, 곧 시댁이나 처가 식구를 한꺼번에 가리켜요.

sentences.ko: 모퉁이에 있는 그 커피집 원래 내가 제일 좋아하던 데였는데, 주인이 바뀌고 나서는 뭘 마셔도 좀 탄 맛이 나. 그러니까 가는 길에 딱 있어서 아직 가긴 가는데, 이제 별로 기대는 안 돼.
sentences.text: That coffee place on the corner used to be my favorite, but it changed owners and now everything tastes kind of burnt. I mean, I still go because it's right on my way, but I don't really look forward to it anymore.

alts.text: I used to love the coffee place on the corner, but new owners took over and now it all tastes kinda burnt. I still go 'cause it's right on my way, but I'm not really excited about it anymore.

The coffee shop on the corner was once my favorite, but it has changed ownership and now everything tastes somewhat burnt. I do still go, since it is directly on my way, but I no longer look forward to it.

sentences.note: **look forward to** 는 무언가를 기다리며 기대한다는 뜻이에요. **right on my way** 는 가는 길에 바로 있다는 말이에요.

sentences.ko: 목요일에 친구가 꼬셔서 스피닝 수업에 갔거든. 예전에 자전거 맨날 탔으니까 괜찮겠지 했는데, 다음 날 아침에 일어나니까 몸살 난 것처럼 온몸이 쑤시더라. 오랜만에 하는 건데 너무 무리했나 봐.
sentences.text: My friend talked me into a spin class on Thursday, and I figured I'd be fine since I used to ride all the time, but I woke up the next morning feeling like I had the flu, my whole body aching. I think I just pushed way too hard for my first time back.

alts.text: Thursday my friend got me to go to spin class. I figured I'd be fine, I used to ride all the time, but next morning I felt like I had the flu, everything hurt. Guess I went way too hard my first time back.

On Thursday my friend persuaded me to attend a spin class, and I assumed I would be fine since I used to ride regularly. However, I woke the next morning feeling as though I had the flu, with my whole body aching. I believe I simply pushed far too hard for my first time back.

sentences.note: **talked me into** 는 나를 설득해서 뭔가를 하게 만들었다는 말이에요. **pushed way too hard** 는 너무 무리했다는 뜻이에요.

sentences.ko: 잠깐, 지난번에 봤을 때 너 다시 학교 다닐까 생각 중이었잖아. 결국 갔어, 아니면 아직 같은 회사 다녀?
sentences.text: Wait, last time I saw you, you were thinking about going back to school. Did you end up doing that, or are you still at the same place?

alts.text: Hang on, weren't you thinking about going back to school last time? Did you do it, or are you still at the same job?
When we last spoke, you were considering returning to school. Did you decide to do so, or are you still with the same employer?

sentences.note: **end up doing** 은 결국 어떻게 하게 됐는지 물을 때 써요. **the same place** 는 여기서 같은 직장을 가리켜요.

sentences.ko: 그래서 휴대폰 케이스를 시켰는데, 정작 온 건 강아지 스웨터였어. 우리 집엔 개도 없는데! 반품하려면 송장을 뽑아서 우체국까지 내가 직접 가져가야 하는데, 솔직히 12달러 때문에 그럴 가치는 없어.
sentences.text: So I ordered a phone case, and what actually showed up was a dog sweater. We don't even have a dog! And to send it back I'd have to print a label and take it to the post office myself, which honestly isn't worth it for twelve bucks.

alts.text: Okay, I ordered a phone case and got a dog sweater instead. We don't even have a dog! Sending it back means printing a label and dragging it to the post office myself, and honestly that's not worth it for twelve bucks.

I ordered a phone case, but what arrived was a sweater for a dog. We do not even own a dog! To return it, I would need to print a label and bring it to the post office myself, which frankly is not worth the effort for twelve dollars.

sentences.note: **showed up** 은 물건이 도착했다는 말로도 써요. **isn't worth it** 은 들이는 수고에 비해 그만한 가치가 없다는 뜻이에요.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 3번 한국어 '오랜만에 처음 하는 건데'는 오랜만에와 처음이 겹쳐 어색해서 '오랜만에 하는 건데'로 고침
